body.name: Fixed-location contact-radius diagnostic
body.construction: For each fixed \(x\in\mathbb R\), \(R_{\mathrm c}(x)\in[0,\infty]\) is the least symmetric radius outside which the constrained and unconstrained GCM slopes agree, with \(\inf\varnothing=\infty\). This is a diagnostic definition only: no almost-sure finiteness uniform in \(x\), tail bound, separability, padding theorem, or grid approximation is included.
